Session cache of eigenvalues

Source: R/eigenCache.R
markovchainCache.Rd

Functions of the package that need the eigenvalues of a transition matrix (slem, spectralGap, relaxationTime, impliedTimescales, topologicalEntropy, aggregateStates with k = NULL, autoplot(type = "eigenvalues") and summary(details = TRUE)) compute them once per matrix and keep them for the rest of the R session, so that calling several of these functions on the same chain does not repeat the \(O(n^3)\) eigen-decomposition.

Details

A stored result is reused only for a matrix bitwise identical to the one it was computed from (state names are ignored), so results are exactly the same with or without the cache. The most recently used matrices are kept within a memory budget.

Options

markovchain.cache

Logical; FALSE switches the cache off. Default TRUE.

markovchain.cacheSize

Memory budget of the cache in bytes, default 64 * 1024^2 (64 MiB). A matrix larger than the budget is not stored.

Examples

mc <- new("markovchain", states = c("a", "b", "c"),
  transitionMatrix = matrix(c(0.5, 0.3, 0.2,
                              0.1, 0.8, 0.1,
                              0.3, 0.3, 0.4), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE))
slem(mc)          # computes the eigenvalues
#> [1] 0.5
spectralGap(mc)   # reuses them
#> [1] 0.5

# switch the cache off for the rest of the session
old <- options(markovchain.cache = FALSE)
spectralGap(mc)
#> [1] 0.5
options(old)
